# CJ 5-inch reference fixture

`cj-5inch-guide-2025-11-05.pdf` is the reference guide used to shape the bundled 5-inch preview. The guide identifies the label as 123 × 100 mm and contains both a dimensioned layout and a clean sample.

The guide uses sample shipment data, not a live customer label. Keep later carrier-issued samples sanitized, preserve page dimensions/orientation/scale, and record the form revision, printer/media settings, source, and redistribution authorization in `source.md`.

Use the PDF as a visual and field-layout reference. It does not issue valid tracking numbers or routing data; generated defaults in the package remain illustrative.
